note: right-hand-rules-apart (part 4 of the right-hand page, item 128): every check is on one page, docs/checks.md, as a safety stop (money, keys and passwords, deleting, publishing, committing; on for every project, no switch) or a house rule (how a chat talks, asks, reports and orders; its own switch per project: "house_rules": {"<name>": false} in the project's profile). A house rule switched off never reaches that project, no refusal and no note. A house rule made later starts off for every project but Muster. A refusal names its group and rule. A project profile with no house_rules key behaves exactly as before (PINR unchanged; profiles/pinr.json is not touched).
